# Third-party: dither-kit-lite

`dither-kit-lite.js`, `dither-kit.css` and `bayer-matrices.json` come from the SuperCompress brand pack
(Copyright (c) 2026 Arjun Shah, MIT License). dither-kit-lite is a vanilla canvas port of the paint
primitives of [Tripwire dither-kit](https://www.tripwire.sh/dither-kit). All credit for the original
dither-kit design goes to Tripwire. We found no license published for the original; see its page for terms.

Local changes: palette entries added at runtime by `assets/app.js`; one comment character in `dither-kit.css`.
